facts.fact: UN-Habitat says Garowe's IFMIS and mobile money tax system handles receipt processing and generation of bills through the digital system, with local revenue up threefold from properties, business and public transport taxes.
The system, piloted in Garowe, was being expanded in August 2021 to four more Puntland districts (Bosaso, Burtinle, Galkayo, Gardo), five districts in all; no total of local governments is given.

The system is supported by UN-Habitat through the Joint Programme on Local Governance, implemented through the Puntland Ministry of Interior with the telecom firm Golis; finance is described as programme-supported.
In August 2021 the mobile taxation system was expanded from Garowe to four more Puntland districts.
